episodeTitle.en: Using behavioral science to improve your product | Kristen Berman (Irrational Labs)
episodeTitle.zh: 利用行为科学优化产品 | 克里斯汀·伯曼（Irrational Labs）

guestBioOfficial.en: Kristen Berman is the CEO and co-founder of Irrational Labs, where she helps companies like Google, Airbnb, PayPal, Microsoft, and LinkedIn improve their products and services through behavioral design research. She is also the co-founder of Common Cents Lab, a Duke University initiative dedicated to improving the financial well-being of low- to middle-class Americans. In today’s episode, Kristen shares the 3B Framework of Behavioral Design and uses real-life examples to illustrate what influences behavior change and the common biases that get in the way of building successful products. She also explains how to keep users engaged and how you can implement behavioral design research to drive innovation and growth.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 克里斯汀·伯曼（Kristen Berman）是Irrational Labs的首席执行官兼联合创始人，她通过行为设计研究帮助谷歌、爱彼家、贝宝、微软和领英等公司优化产品与服务。同时，她还是杜克大学"共同分钱实验室"（Common Cents Lab）的联合创始人，该项目致力于提升美国中低收入群体的财务健康水平。在本期节目中，克里斯汀分享了行为设计的"3B框架"，并通过真实案例解析影响行为改变的因素以及阻碍产品成功的常见偏见。她还将讲述如何保持用户参与度，以及如何运用行为设计研究来推动创新与增长。

title.en: Using behavioral science to improve your product | Kristen Berman (Irrational Labs)
title.zh: 利用行为科学优化产品 | 克里斯汀·伯曼（Irrational Labs）

summary.en: Kristen explains how behavioral science reveals that people act on emotion and social norms, not pure rationality, and how products can be designed to steer better behavior. She introduces the 3B Framework of Behavioral Design with real case studies, including work with TikTok. The episode shows how to apply psychology to drive engagement and growth without manipulation.
summary.zh: 克里斯滕解释了行为科学如何揭示：人是基于情绪与社会规范行事，而非纯粹理性，以及产品如何被设计来引导更好的行为。她以 TikTok 等真实案例介绍了"行为设计 3B 框架"。本期展示了如何运用心理学推动用户参与和增长，且不带操纵色彩。
